body: Tuned for endurance and precision, this 2024 Mercedes Sprinter 170 AWD is a balance of power and refinement—engineered for travelers who move between backroads and remote worksites with confidence. Inside and out, every system has been designed for self-sufficiency, efficiency, and seamless integration.

The electrical system anchors the build with a robust foundation: eight 100Ah Battle Born lithium batteries feed a 3000-watt AIMS inverter/charger, Victron Orion XS 50A DC–DC charger, and SmartSolar MPPT 100/30 controller. Together they deliver reliable off-grid power to every onboard amenity—from the Bosch hot water system and Isotherm Cruise 130 fridge to the Nomadic X2 air conditioner and full perimeter lighting package.

Smart organization defines the layout. The driver-side electrical compartment features labeled Blue Sea fuse blocks, dedicated breakers, and Noctua cooling for optimal performance. Opposite, the passenger-side plumbing bay houses a 33-gallon freshwater tank, dual tank heater pads, and a Shurflo pump system—built to withstand freezing nights and long miles.

Above, the SCA manual pop-top opens to a view and a breath of air, with integrated LED strip lighting wired independently from the main cabin system. Three 100W Renogy solar panels curve cleanly into the roofline, quietly recharging the power bank as the van sits under open skies.

Inside, the control panel is the nerve center—housing relays for every function from tank heaters to lighting, all arranged with Papago’s signature attention to order and detail. Each switch, screen, and relay is mounted with precision: the Renogy battery monitor, AIMS LCD remote, and neatly arranged round toggles in black or stainless to match the interior hardware.

Outside, the ARB air compressor stands ready beside a full lighting suite—two driver side, two rear, and two passenger side fixtures—each controlled by custom switches at their respective doors. Whether illuminating a mountain pass campsite or a jobsite after dark, the Sarracino Build performs with the reliability and clarity of purpose that define every Papago creation.
Durable, capable, and thoughtfully engineered, this Sprinter isn’t just a van—it’s a power plant, workspace, and adventure platform built to thrive far from the grid.
